items.title: Universal Health Services (UHS) Option Volatility Spike Keeps Undervalued Case In Focus
items.summary: Options activity around Universal Health Services (UHS) has sharpened focus on the stock, after the October 16, 2026 $360 put ranked among the highest implied volatility equity contracts in the market. At a share price of $174.26, Universal Health Services has seen short term momentum soften, with the 1 day share price return down 0.84% and the 7 day share price return down 3.93%.
